scope: Existing typed lesson/review correctness boundaries; executable tests and code review, not a formal proof or new formal-checker architecture.

rules.title: Receipt cutoff and immutable evidence
rules.requirement: Review input is a copied immutable snapshot of the current episode with receiptTime <= the authored checkpoint cutoff. Event occurrence alone never makes a later-received report available. Citations must be allowed for the criterion and eligible at that cutoff.
rules.limit: Citation eligibility does not establish that free-form feedback is semantically entailed by those citations.

rules.title: Episode, run, checkpoint and aircraft identity
rules.requirement: The server selects the lesson target and checkpoint; input/run/revision/checkpoint and output episode/checkpoint must match. A report about another aircraft is allowed only when authorized by the criterion, such as the occupying aircraft in a stand-availability task.
rules.limit: Valid identities do not prove that an unconstrained natural-language or visual referent was understood correctly; this contract binds typed checkpoint reviews to the server-selected target.

rules.title: External clock and checkpoint freeze
rules.requirement: Source time stops at each checkpoint during idle, pending, failed review and feedback. Continue resumes from that cutoff without accumulating the wall time spent waiting; model latency does not advance the scenario.
rules.limit: Driver freeze is automated-tested and native fog transition samples support60/120/180 freezing. Source-time-jump absence and visual display behavior are root-reported; this is not a formal trace proof.

rules.title: Authenticated bounded learner data
rules.requirement: The typed request is authenticated, has exactly five required fields, a true integer revision and nonblank responseText of 1–1,200 characters. Its streamed body is capped at 16,384 bytes before JSON parsing. Learner instructions remain JSON string data under the fixed prompt.
rules.limit: This is a bounded application-input contract, not a general security or prompt-injection-resistance certification.

rules.title: Duplicate and conflicting requests
rules.requirement: Within the current in-memory attempt, the same actionId and body returns its pending or cached result without another inference or answer. Reusing the ID with changed data is rejected.
rules.limit: Idempotency is scoped to the running service/attempt; no persistence across process restart is claimed.

rules.title: Stale completion rejection
rules.requirement: A completion may change state only when immutable run, revision, phase, checkpoint, actionId, fingerprint and stored review context still match. A timed-out, replaced or old-run result is discarded.
rules.limit: This checks context correctness, not the semantic correctness of an otherwise current model response.

rules.title: Single inference and timeout ownership
rules.requirement: Typed review and ordinary conversation share one app inference lock. A retained background task holds it until inference finishes, including after the 60-second typed wait or client disconnection; a competing retry receives 429. Late timed-out output is not applied.
rules.limit: Verified with gated fake inference. The lock is process-local, not distributed; an indefinitely hung inference can remain unavailable until it ends or the service is deliberately restarted.

rules.title: Visible failure, retry and no scripted fallback
rules.requirement: Invalid output or model failure leaves the checkpoint and original learner text available with an error. It adds no answer and substitutes no scripted positive feedback. A fresh retry succeeds after the prior worker has finished.
rules.limit: Legacy choice checks require explicit internal choice mode and are not an automatic fallback for typed responses.

rules.title: Strict review contract and semantic boundary
rules.requirement: A review needs exact JSON/schema, unique keys, ordered criteria, eligible citations, exact learner substrings for met/contradicted points and a consistent verdict. Any contradicted point means needs_review; missing uses an empty quote. No prose extraction, quote repair or answer fabrication is applied.
rules.limit: Automated validation does not prove entailment, attribution, omission detection, teaching quality or broad injection resistance. V2 had 14 usable reviews and 4 withheld failures; the later v3 diagnostic displayed two semantic errors and was rejected. A limited v2 functional acceptance claim cannot be treated as semantic-reliability validation.

rules.title: Typed public state and qualitative feedback
rules.requirement: Normal lessons use typed responses. Before submission, the public checkpoint exposes only id, at and question; it contains no choices or answer key. Typed feedback/debrief has no numerical score, and a legacy answer action cannot switch the mode.
rules.limit: Private authored rubrics guide practice feedback. This is not validated grading, certification or a competence assessment.

rules.title: Native stale-response and draft guard
rules.requirement: The typed response coroutine checks activeReviewId, run, checkpoint and phase before changing current UI state; older revisions are ignored. Drafts are keyed by run/checkpoint outside the rebuilt input widget and retained during polling and layout changes.
rules.limit: Full native fog checks cover draft rotation, pending polls, actual error/edit/retry and Try again. This reviewer independently checked saved audits, hashes and transition records, not the native UI. No exhaustive Unity race test, physical-device or process-restart draft-persistence claim.

rules.title: Visual and reported authority stay separate
rules.requirement: Authored fog improvement is visual context. Low-visibility procedures, safeguarding, hold status and departure-clearance confirmation come from received reports; one cancellation or a clearer view cannot grant clearance. The short lesson uses authored timings, not operational durations or RVR thresholds.
rules.limit: Official source distinctions support the lesson design; no live Heathrow procedure activation, calibrated RVR, operational instruction or exact incident reconstruction is claimed.
